# word_2019

word_2019 gives Obsidian the visual style of Microsoft Word 2019, with familiar menus, fonts and colour palette. Its recorded description describes a clean, ribbon-inspired layout applied to replicate Word's look while Markdown readability and note clarity are kept.

![word_2019 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sir-marc-the-scribe/Obsidian-theme---word-office-2019/HEAD/screenshot.png)
